categories.name: All Modes
categories.rules:
General rules- All highscore modes and classic mode must be completed, mixer modes and vip modes are not required.

Using the leave button is not allowed, only failing once achieving the required score is allowed.

Timing starts upon the first input of the first mode.Timing ends upon reaching the end screen after reaching the required score

Category Specific rules-

0 points- all highscore modes including classic mode but no vip modes, no mixer modes, fail the level as quickly as possible.

10 points- you must achieve 10 points in every highscore and must fail the level once the objective is complete not leave.

All variants- a variant for example is in classic mode there's 4 variants, 20,50,100,200. You must do all of those. There's 216 accounting for subcategories 

One Variant- one variant is for example in classic mode just doing 1 of the 4 sub modes. theres 120 modes

As for the timer, I’m not sure how to get those set up… this is technically my first official speedrun. But I can say that based on multiple studies, I find the game to be as reliable as my phone’s stopwatch, but I’ll leave the placement up to you. iPhone 16 Pro Max, Natural Titanium, 512GB, running iOS 18.2 Beta 4

Side Note: If you wondered why it was on my YouTube channel, you can briefly check the About Me pages. My YouTube lacks a name and TotKforLife is my Twitch name.
